channel.title: AI News Radar
channel.description: A curated 24-hour radar of AI news: official releases, new models and high-signal discussion.

item.title: Build a Robot Pick-and-Place Simulation with SimReady Assets
item.description: A beverage-can pick-and-place scene in Isaac Sim uses a UR17G arm, Robotiq 2F-140 gripper and SimReady Central assets, with joint, motion and contact behavior tested before GPT-6 Sol-generated controls run the task. (Hugging Face Blog)

item.title: Gemini 4 Hydrogen in GitHub Copilot
item.description: Gemini 4 Hydrogen, Google's latest Flash model, is now generally available in GitHub Copilot for fast agentic coding, tool use and multistep workflows, with improved instruction following over Gemini 3.8 Flash and provider list pricing. (GitHub Changelog)

item.title: Introducing ChatGPT Wallet
item.description: OpenAI's page titled Introducing ChatGPT Wallet currently returns only an "Internal Server Error," with no body text, product features or details loaded beyond the title and an "OpenAI © 2015–2026" footer. (OpenAI News)

item.title: XYBench: Helping with the problem behind the question
item.description: Ai2’s XYBench tests AI assistants on 8,115 real questions containing XY-problem misconceptions—such as frosting that slides off cupcakes—to see whether they address the user’s underlying goal, and it won EMNLP 2026’s Best Resource Paper Award. (Hugging Face Blog)

item.title: Upcoming deprecation of selected GitHub Copilot models in December
item.description: GitHub will retire selected Copilot models across Copilot Chat, inline edits, ask and agent modes, and code completions on December 14, 2026, with Claude Haiku 4.5 still available to individual annual subscribers and affected users needing to update workflows. (GitHub Changelog)

item.title: Exercise, diet, and sleep can all cause blood sugar fluctuations. Qwen now integrates with continuous glucose monitors and launches "Analyze My Blood Sugar.
item.description: Qwen's Health Record added Continuous Glucose Monitor integration on November 14, syncing blood glucose data 24/7 after user authorization and combining it with diet, exercise and sleep analysis, such as flagging high-GI staples when lunch routinely includes congee and baozi. (AIbase)

item.title: GitHub Enterprise Server support in the GitHub Copilot app
item.description: GitHub Copilot app 1.2.0 makes GitHub Enterprise Server account support generally available after an opt-in preview, letting users work with remote repositories, issues and pull requests, though GHES cloud sessions remain unsupported. (GitHub Changelog)

item.title: llama.cpp v1.0.0 : A stronger foundation for the local AI ecosystem
item.description: llama.cpp v1.0.0 marks the project’s first major release after 3.5 years, setting an API/ABI compatibility boundary while supporting over 150 model architecture variants, mainstream speculative decoding, and CI expanded via NVIDIA, AMD hardware and HF Jobs. (Hugging Face Blog)

item.title: Manage AI Scan for repositories using the REST API
item.description: GitHub's AI Scan now exposes a repository_scan REST API setting for organization- and repository-level enablement in public preview, and conflicting updates sent alongside pr_scan return a 422 error. (GitHub Changelog)

item.title: Keep Opus 5.5 as your coding default in Claude Code. On 52 coding tasks in Claude Code 2.1.322, Fable 5.2 solved about as many (82.7% vs 84.6%) but cost 2.80x as much per solved task. Opus already solves most of these...
item.description: On 52 coding tasks in Claude Code 2.1.322, Fable 5.2 solved 82.7% versus Opus 5.5's 84.6% but cost 2.80x as much per solved task, supporting the recommendation to keep Opus 5.5 as the default. (Follow Builders · X · Garry Tan)

item.title: Export-banned Nvidia chips are behind China’s most powerful AI models — uh oh, Jensen!
item.description: New research indicates China's most advanced AI models were trained on Nvidia chips barred by export bans, and the article examines what that means for Nvidia and Jensen Huang. (TechCrunch AI)

item.title: Claude Meetings — Add Claude to your call and get work started as you talk
item.description: Claude Meetings promises to add Claude to your call so work starts as you talk, but the page itself shows only a CAPTCHA verification screen, not the actual features or details. (Product Hunt)

item.title: Trainn MCP — Create product videos and courses from any AI chat
item.description: Trainn MCP claims it can generate product videos and courses from any AI chat, yet its page currently returns a 403 with only a security-verification prompt, leaving features and demos unshown. (Product Hunt)

item.title: ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp — Chrome DevTools for coding agents
item.description: chrome-devtools-mcp exposes a Model Context Protocol server and CLI that let Claude and Cursor control and inspect a live Chrome browser for automation, debugging, and performance analysis. (GitHub Trending)

item.title: Anthropic Upgrades Claude Code Projects to Run Parallel AI Workers Hands-Free
item.description: Anthropic added a proactive coordinator, shareable read-only threads, reminders, and /btw and /fork commands to Claude Code Projects, capping accounts at 200 threads per day.

item.title: Claude Conference
item.description: Claude can now join Google Meet calls as a visible participant on Team and Enterprise plans in beta, taking notes, answering questions and building docs and whiteboards during the meeting, then saving transcripts, summaries and action items on claude.ai. (claude.com)

item.title: Unsloth Qwen 3.8-27B quantization — Dynamic v3.1 update
item.description: Unsloth's Dynamic V3.1 quantization of Qwen3.8-27B, a 27B dense vision-and-reasoning model with a 256K context window that runs on 17GB of RAM or VRAM, claims 5-10% accuracy gains on Terminal Bench and DeepSWE at the same size. (unsloth.ai)

item.title: Rejecting Shoddy AI: A Manifesto
item.description: The No AI Slop Manifesto, released by speakers and attendees of AIE Code Summit 2026, mirrors the 2001 Agile Manifesto written by 17 engineers in Snowbird, Utah, and sets out five value pairs such as "Outcomes over output" urging developers to prioritize understanding and independent thinking over raw AI output. (www.slopmanifesto.com)

item.title: OpenAI disbands its robotics team as its general-purpose models begin operating robots
item.description: OpenAI has dissolved its standalone robotics team, moving researchers into Mark Chen's main research group and Greg Brockman's Applied org, betting models like GPT-6 Astra can directly control robots ahead of a planned 2027 humanoid demo. (fortune.com)

item.title: Gemini 4 Hydrogen — Fast agentic development for coders
item.description: The page titled "Gemini 4 Hydrogen" promises fast agentic development for coders but contains only a CAPTCHA bot-verification prompt, offering no actual product details, data or agentic coding content. (Product Hunt)
